description: One token's USD price with the block and time it was read at, 24h change and volume, the pool the price comes from, and whether liquidity is low. price_time is when the price last changed, age_seconds is how old that is now, and indexed_time and indexed_block say how far the chain's indexing has got. When stale is true the price must not be presented as the current price; say how old it is instead. Use search_tokens first when you only know the symbol.

address.description: Token contract address (0x and 40 hex digits, any case)

name: get_token
title: Get a token's price
